method: analytical kinetic theory (Boltzmann equation) for intraband conductivity
model_system: two‑dimensional electron gas (graphene with linear dispersion and parabolic 2DEG)

key_params.electron_density_n\u2091: sets Drude conductivity σ = e² nₑ τ₁ /m (or v_F for graphene)
key_params.effective_mass_m_or_vF: parabolic m or graphene Fermi velocity v_F
key_params.dielectric_indices_n1_n2: refractive indices of media above/below the 2DEG
key_params.temperature: classical regime ℏΩ,ℏω ≪ mean electron energy

headline_claim: At Ω≈ω and Ω·τ₁≈1, the pump‑induced Faraday and Kerr rotation angles reach ≈0.1° per 1 kW/cm² pump intensity in graphene, equivalent to a synthetic magnetic field of ~0.1 T.
replication_difficulty: medium – requires analytical solution of the Boltzmann equation and evaluation of derived formulas, but no heavy numerics.
